content: Good afternoon, this is Officer James Porter with the Internal Revenue Service, badge number 532849. Am I speaking with Casey Miller?
Yes, this is Casey. Um, is something wrong?
I'm calling concerning your 2022 and 2023 federal tax filings. According to our records, there is a discrepancy and your account has been flagged for a potential tax liability adjustment.
Wait, what? I just started my job last year. I thought I filled everything out right.

I understand this can be confusing. The IRS has recently implemented a Taxpayer Relief Initiative for individuals in your situation. You may qualify to have a significant portion of your outstanding liability forgiven.
I didn't know I owed anything. How much is it?
Our preliminary audit indicates a balance of $2,167 due to errors in your reported income. However, with the initiative, you could settle for as little as $480 if you act today.
That sounds like a lot... Is this real? I never got a letter.

Due to the urgency of your case, it has escalated to a direct phone notification. If you do not resolve this today, the IRS may initiate wage garnishment or legal proceedings. I want to avoid that for you.
Oh wow. Um, what am I supposed to do?
To enroll in the relief program, there is a mandatory legal preparation fee of $480. This secures your eligibility and halts any further action against you.
Okay... How do I pay the fee?
For expedited processing, we require payment via Zelle. Please have your mobile banking app ready. I will provide the account details.
I think I have Zelle. Do I need to send it to the IRS?
Yes. Please send the payment to irs-reliefoffice@consultant.com. Once you confirm the transaction, I will update your case status.
Alright, give me a second. Can you repeat the email address?
Certainly. It's irs-reliefoffice@consultant.com. Please ensure you enter it exactly as stated to avoid delays.
Okay, I think I have it. Should I put anything in the message?
Include your full name and 'Relief Program Enrollment' in the memo. After the payment, please provide me with the confirmation number.
Alright, I'll try to send it now. What happens after I send the money?
Once we receive the payment, your case file will be flagged for settlement, and you will receive an official letter of clearance from the IRS within 3 to 5 business days.
